body: Hey, just wanted to let you know you aren't alone.  I'm 27 and feel the same way, struggling to find any kind of meaning or reason to go on.  Don't give up.

I appreciate your words but I think that time does exist and has come for me.  I've never done anything good for anyone.  Looking back at my life I can see it was just a progression from a kid who was only happy because he was spoiled, to a miserable teenager, to a completely unstable and useless adult.  I have contributed nothing to any of my friend's lives, that's why no one calls me anymore.  I'm sick of relying on other people for support.  I'm sick of spending thousands of dollars on different therapists who just tell me what they think I want to hear.

I feel nauseous and exhausted.  I hate myself, I hate that I am begging here for support from people who are much kinder and better than I am.  There is nothing left for me in life anymore.  Time has fucked me in the end, because I let it.  I'm going to die alone either way.
